summary: Iteration 12: Tested OpenFDA integration, Peptide Comparison Tool, and Swipe Navigation. Fixed critical bug in OpenFDA search query (URL encoding issue). All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed OpenFDA search query - httpx was double-encoding the + signs in OR operators, breaking the FDA API query. Changed to use space-separated terms and manual URL construction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features working: 1) FDA Search in Research tab Medications section - search for 'ibuprofen' returns 10 IBUPROFEN results with drug class, uses, boxed warnings, and ADD buttons, 2) Add medication from FDA results - clicking ADD button adds medication to local list (count increased from 20 to 21), 3) Peptide Comparison - Compare Peptides button enters compare mode with checkboxes, selecting 2+ peptides shows Compare (N) button, clicking opens comparison modal with side-by-side attribute comparison, 4) Swipe Navigation - nav dots at bottom (Home, Calculator, Research, Journal, Profile) work correctly, clicking navigates to correct page, active page is highlighted, 5) Page indicator dots update correctly when changing pages

bug_fixed.root_cause: httpx client was URL-encoding the + signs in the search query, converting '+OR+' to '%2BOR%2B' which broke the FDA API OR operator
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed search query to use space-separated terms instead of +OR+ and constructed URL manually to avoid double-encoding
bug_fixed.verification: FDA search for 'ibuprofen' now correctly returns IBUPROFEN medications
